name: B10-0440/2025 (Renew) – Arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Equatorial Guinea for holding two Spanish citizens, Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta, without a fair trial since January 2025. It asks that they get medical care, visits from family, lawyers and Spanish officials, and a fair trial. It also asks Spain and the European Union to push harder for their release and to consider sanctions.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks for action; it cannot order it.
- **Who it affects:** The two detained men, their families, Spain, and Equatorial Guinea's government.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the EU's foreign policy chief, the Council, the Commission and others, who decide whether to act.
